note: The Holdings Table (d66) and its holdings (Playtest v1.11, pp. 142–146). `income` and `ransack` are rolled at the table; `turns` is what a holding becomes after the income on the roll named; `gives` comes with each income.

holdings.name: Ruined Hovel
holdings.text: A burnt out husk of a building. Digging through the detritus might offer up a few scraps of worth.

holdings.name: Rat-catcher's Shack
holdings.text: At the plague's onset, rat-catchers made good coin. There might still be some silver inside.

holdings.name: Intact Town House
holdings.text: With its windows and doors still barred, there might be something of worth inside.

holdings.name: Dilapidated Guild Shoppe
holdings.text: In addition, roll once on the Curiosities table.

holdings.name: Burnt Down Smithy
holdings.text: In addition, roll a dice: 1–2 Pile of Daggers, add d3 Daggers to your stash; 3–4 Shield Rack, add d3 Shields to your stash; 5–6 Wall of Swords, add d3 Swords to your stash.

holdings.name: Old Tavern

rules.name: Drink Deep
rules.text: When you ransack this holding, every fighter in your warband earns 5 bonus experience.

holdings.text: The ales have long fouled, but a stash of spirits and wines remain, ready to be sold.

holdings.name: Moneylender's House
holdings.text: Skeletal remains of the moneylender hang at the building's entrance. Inside you find an unopened coin chest.

holdings.name: Jewelsmith
holdings.text: Hidden behind barricaded windows and doors of an unassuming building, you find a trove of rare stones.

rules.name: Run Dry
rules.text: If the d6 roll to determine the income is a 1, the supply of eels runs out. After the income is collected, this holding becomes a Ruined Hovel.

rules.name: Drink Unclean Waters
rules.text: Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, a fighter can drink from the well. If they do so, you can remove 1 of their temporary injuries, but they gain 1 level of Black Rot.

rules.name: Spy the City
rules.text: This holding grants 1 exploration re-roll when the controlling warband explores the City.

rules.name: Depleted
rules.text: If the d6 roll to determine the income is a 1, the remaining tunnels are exhausted. After the income is collected, this holding is removed.

rules.name: Fresh from the Canals
rules.text: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive 1 Jar of Canal Leeches.

holdings.name: Drawbridge Crossing
holdings.text: This small drawbridge spans one of the City's many canals, and those who wish to cross must pay its toll.

rules.name: Grave Digging
rules.text: Each time you collect income from this holding, if you roll one or more 6's you can roll on the Curiosity Table.

rules.name: Apothecary's Wares
rules.text: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive 1 Healing Tonic.

holdings.name: Salt Cellar
holdings.text: An old basement storehouse lined with barrels and sacks of precious salt.

rules.name: Going, Going, Gone
rules.text: Whenever you sell a Curiosity you receive an additional d6 silver. Whenever you sell a Relic you receive an additional 2d6 silver.

rules.name: Alchemists' Wares
rules.text: Each time you collect income from this holding, roll a dice: 1 nothing extra; 2 a Tonic of Speed; 3 a Tonic of Strength; 4 a Tonic of Fortitude; 5 a Blinding Powder; 6 an Alchemist's Fire.

rules.name: Arrival by Tunnel
rules.text: Once per battle, when a fighter from the warband that controls this holding gets the Outflank result on the reinforcement table, they can emerge from the tunnels. If they do so, set up the fighter anywhere on the battlefield floor, more than 6" from all enemy fighters.

rules.name: Drink Pure Waters
rules.text: Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, a fighter can drink from the well. If they do so, you can remove 1 of their temporary injuries.

rules.name: The Water Blackens
rules.text: If the income roll for this holding is a triple, after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Tainted Well.

rules.name: Poisonous Wares
rules.text: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive d3 Vials of Poison.

rules.name: Discovered
rules.text: If the income roll for this holding is a double, after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Ruined Hovel.

rules.name: Curious Wares
rules.text: Each time you collect income from this holding, you can roll once on the Curiosity Table.

rules.name: Hiring Workers
rules.text: You cannot collect income from this holding until you have hired workers. Hiring workers costs 10 silver and is done once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence. Once workers are hired, income can be collected from the following aftermath sequence onwards. If another warband gains control of this holding, the workers need to be hired once more.

rules.name: Collapse
rules.text: If the income roll for this holding is a triple, after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Collapsed Mine.

rules.name: The Trials of the Tower
rules.text: When a warband first takes control of this holding, it has 3 wards remaining; keep track of them, also when another warband takes control of it. Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, the warband that controls this holding can send its Leader or a Champion to attempt to bypass a ward: make a Willpower test for that fighter. If passed, 1 ward is removed. If failed, make an injury roll for the fighter. When all wards have been removed, roll once on the Relic table. Then, this holding becomes a Ruined Tower.
